1.content: Assign the lowest possible (large negative) score to any move that would land on a hole (H) or exit the grid. This penalty must outweigh any positive heuristics, ensuring unsafe moves are never selected. Apply this safety check before any other scoring.

2.content: Give higher scores to moves that reduce the Manhattan distance to the goal. Select the move that most decreases this distance, but only after confirming it does not violate the safety rule above.
